CursorParams.description: Live feeds (Pulse, messages) use a cursor, not offsets: new items arriving must not shift the next page.
CursorParams.title: CursorParams

alt_text.description: What the image shows, for people using a screen reader
alt_text.title: Alt Text

parent_id.description: Reply to a top-level reply (one level deep only)
parent_id.title: Parent Id

info.description: Circuit backend. Errors always use {error: {code, message, details}}; lists use {items, count, next_offset}.
info.title: Circuit API

patch.description: The startup's team only. applied can become shortlisted or rejected; shortlisted can become hired or rejected. Other people's applications are a 404. The student is notified.

post.description: Students only, my own application. Safe to repeat. Decided applications are a 409.

get.description: The fixed list of capabilities used for needs, offers and skills.
Exchange circuits I am part of, newest first, with live status: who gives what to whom, who has said yes, what has been handed over. A proposal nobody finished answering in 72 hours reads as expired.
A circuit I am part of. Anyone else's circuit is a 404.

post.description: The person giving says they have done their part. When all three are done the circuit is completed. Only the giver can do this, and only while the circuit is active. Safe to repeat.
The person receiving rates the handover from 1 to 5, once it is marked done. The first rating stands.

Each of the three people answers within 72 hours. When all three say yes the circuit becomes active; one no ends it for everyone. Answering the same way again is safe; changing your answer is a 409; an expired proposal is a 409.
post.summary: Say yes or no to a circuit

get.description: People I am connected to. Only I see this list; there are no public counts.
box=incoming (default) or outgoing. Pending ones only, newest first.

post.description: With an optional note of up to 300 characters. If they already asked me, this accepts it. A request to or from someone under 18 must stay inside one organisation; anyone I may not reach is a 404.
Only the person it was sent to. Accepting makes us connections.
post.summary: Accept or decline a connection request

get.description: folder=chats (accepted) or requests (first messages from people I am not connected to). Latest first. Members under 18 never get requests from strangers.

post.description: Sends the first message. Connected people chat directly; others receive it as a request. Someone I may not message (under-18 rules, blocks, hidden profiles) is a 404.

get.description: 404 unless I am one of the two people.

post.description: Only the person the request was sent to.
Closes the conversation and blocks them everywhere (matches, posts, messages, intros).

get.description: Newest first. Pass next_cursor as cursor to load older ones. Read receipts are not shown to senders.

post.description: Text up to 2000 characters, an image, or both. In a request the sender gets one message until the other person answers; answering accepts the request.

get.description: What the client fetches after a Realtime nudge. 404 unless I am in the conversation.

post.description: Marks what the other person sent as read.

get.description: Introductions my members asked for, split into local and Bridge matches, with how many were accepted. The rate appears only when both counts are at least 5.
What my organisation's members need against what they offer, biggest gaps first. Partner admins only, and only for their own organisation. Counts below 5 are hidden.
Members on a grid of roughly 2 km cells; cells with fewer than 5 members are left out. Add capability=<slug> to show only members who need that capability.
Members, new members, matches, introductions, completed circuits and applications for my organisation. Counts below 5 are hidden.
Dev and demo only.

post.description: Dev and demo only.

get.description: Up to 3 people, ready at 08:00 IST, each a Strong or Good match (anything weaker is never dropped). Empty until the daily job has run. Members under 18 get no drop.

post.description: intro or skip. This records the choice only; to ask for the intro, call the intros endpoint next. A person who is not in today's drop is a 404.

get.description: Process is up. Touches no dependencies.
Checks Postgres, Redis and the Supabase JWKS (skipped when SUPABASE_URL is unset). Redis down is degraded, not failed, because Postgres is the source of truth.
box=sent (what I asked for), received (requests that reached me), brokered (where I am the mutual connection). Newest first. can_respond says whether it is my turn to answer.

post.description: Ask for an introduction to someone through my best mutual connection, who is asked first and then the person. 201 for a new request, 200 if one is already open (safe to repeat). At most 3 new requests a week; 409 if the person is not taking more introductions this week. Not available for under-18 accounts. Rate limited.

get.description: Who would introduce me to this person: the best mutual connection within two hops. 404 if the person is hidden or I have no mutual connection.

post.description: The person who asked rates how it went, 1 to 5. Only after it was accepted. Safe to repeat.
The mutual connection answers first (accepting means vouching), then the person. Answering again is safe. Not my turn is a 409; a request I am not part of is a 404.

get.description: Open jobs with filters (kind, capability, startup, distance from my location or the city centre, minimum stipend). Students get skill_match (0 to 1) and the best match first; everyone else gets newest first.

post.description: Founders on a claimed startup's team. Needs 1 to 8 capabilities from the fixed list. Marks the startup as hiring.

get.description: One job. Students see their skill match and which required skills they have. A closed job is visible to its team only.

patch.description: The startup's team only. Set is_open to false to close it. Changing capabilities re-scores existing applications.

get.description: The startup's team only. Ranked by skill match, then earliest application. College is not shown or used.

post.description: Students only, one click. 201 for a new application, 200 if I had already applied (safe to repeat). A withdrawn application is reopened. Closed jobs are a 409. Rate limited.

get.description: Up to 12 updates from the last 24 hours (shipped, hiring, needs, joined, closed a circuit), most relevant to me first, unseen before seen. Each has one line of what happened, why it matters to me, and one action. No view or reaction counts.

post.description: Call when an update is opened. A key that is not on my wire is a 404.

get.description: People who fit what I need and offer, best first, each with a one-line reason. Computed ahead of time, so this is a cheap read. bridge=true shows only Bridge matches (different sector), bridge=false only the rest. Partner admins and super admins have no matches.
The signed-in member's own profile and settings.

patch.description: Send only the fields to change. Role may be student, founder, mentor or investor (admin roles are set by Circuit). Joining circuits needs verification level 2. Under-18 members stay students and are never public.

get.description: Students: my applications with their status, newest first.
Newest first. Only I can see this list.
What I am looking for help with.

put.description: Replaces my needs with this list (max 8, capability slugs from /capabilities). Safe to repeat.

get.description: What I can help others with.

put.description: Replaces my offers with this list (max 8, capability slugs from /capabilities). Safe to repeat.

get.description: Skills with level 1-3 and optional proof link.

put.description: Replaces my skills (max 8). Level 1-3; proof_url is optional proof of work. Safe to repeat.

get.description: Trait slugs I picked.

put.description: Replaces my traits (max 10, slugs from /traits). Safe to repeat.

post.description: Sends a code to a work email (not a personal mailbox). Confirm it to reach verification level 2. Rate limited.
Enter the code from the email. On success you reach verification level 2.

Returns a short-lived signed URL for one JPEG, PNG or WebP image of at most 5 MB. Upload the file to it, then call complete. The browser resizes to 1440px first; the server re-encodes and removes metadata.
Checks the uploaded file really is an image, strips metadata and stores two sizes. Safe to repeat. Someone else's upload is a 404.

get.description: Another member's profile. Hidden, under-18, suspended, blocked and admin accounts are a 404.
Newest first, only the ones I am allowed to see. 404 for members I cannot see.
Newest first. Add unread=true for unread only. Payloads hold ids only; look details up with the other endpoints.

post.description: Marks all my notifications read. Returns how many changed.

get.description: How many notifications I have not read.

post.description: Marks one of my notifications read. Safe to repeat. Anyone else's id is a 404.

Reads a pasted bio and suggests items from our fixed lists. Nothing is saved: confirm with the PUT endpoints. If the AI is unavailable, source is 'manual' with empty suggestions and the app shows the pickers. Rate limited.
post.summary: Suggest needs and offers from a bio

post.description: Join an organisation with its invite code. Students, founders, mentors and investors who are not already in one. Rate limited.
Joins the organisation that owns the domain of the email your sign-in provider verified. The email is read from your token, never from the request.
Partner admins cannot leave.

get.description: The organisation I belong to. 404 if none.
Partner admins only. Lists members of their own organisation who chose to be visible to it.

delete.description: Partner admins only. Removes a member from their own organisation; any other id is a 404.

post.description: Up to 4 images (each with alt text), 500 characters, 3 capability tags and an optional link. Members under 18 can only post to their organisation.

delete.description: Author only; anyone else gets a 404.

get.description: 404 unless the post's visibility lets me see it. Reaction totals appear only on my own posts.

put.description: Helpful, intro_me or lets_talk. Safe to repeat. Nobody but the author sees totals.

get.description: Oldest first, nested one level. Replies from people I blocked or who blocked me are left out.

post.description: Up to 300 characters. The post's author is notified.

get.description: Chronological, last 7 days, never ranked. Shows what is new since I last marked Pulse as seen; include_seen=true shows earlier items too. Ends with caught_up=true.

post.description: Call when the member reaches the end. The next visit shows only newer items.

delete.description: The reply's author or the post's author. Anyone else gets a 404.

post.description: Goes to the Circuit moderators. You can only report what you can see (anything else is a 404). Reporting the same thing twice returns the open report.
post.summary: Report a post, reply, message or profile

get.description: Pins inside a bounding box (max about 2 degrees wide, max 500 pins). Hiring startups come first.
Nearest first. Defaults to my saved location, else the city centre. Filters: hiring, capability of an open role, radius.
Profile, open roles, and how many people viewed it or showed interest (a reason to claim it). Counts one view per member per day.

patch.description: Only the team of a claimed startup. Claimed data is never overwritten by anything else.

post.description: Founders only. Sends a code to an email at the startup's own website domain. Rate limited. In dev and demo the code is returned.
Founders only. Enter the emailed code to become the startup's owner (also raises you to verification level 2). Rate limited.
Safe to repeat.
Students only. Tells the startup I'm interested. Safe to repeat.

get.description: Circles for connections, my organisation and startups I follow who posted or opened a role in the last 24 hours. Unseen first. Items are included, so the story viewer needs no second call.

post.description: Call when a circle is opened. A circle that is not in my strip is a 404.

get.description: The fixed list of traits.
